items.title: Horace "One Leg Horse" White Interview, 1961-03-03
items.q: I used to be having a good time with him, man... Sometimes I'll go with him and sit down there and laugh and talk, have a good time with him.

ctx.x: He's happy. He had a brother, Happy.

Yeah. Bill, Happy, and the bass. That's only three brothers. The Matthews brothers. Yeah. I still go by, I still go by his, I still go by him here. He stays on, uh, he stays on Appaloosa Street. Appaloosa between, uh, Socrack and the Shadows Street. So I'll be, I'll be with him all. I'll be, used to be with him. Sometimes I'll go with him and sit down there and laugh and talk, have a good time with him. Sit down there. Sit down there. I used to be having a good time with him, man.
